faculty.name: William Schuler
faculty.summary: Studies computational models of cognitive processes involved in parsing and interpreting speech and text.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知过程在解析和解释语音和文本中的计算模型。

faculty.name: Andrea Sims
faculty.summary: Studies morphological theory and emergent properties of inflectional systems through quantitative methods and graph-theoretic modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究形态学理论和构形系统的涌现属性，通过定量方法和图论建模。

faculty.name: Kathryn Campbell-Kibler
faculty.summary: Studies how Ohioans perceive language differences within the state and how college students modify their speech.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究俄亥俄州居民对语言差异的认知以及大学生在校期间的语音变化。

faculty.name: Cynthia Clopper
faculty.summary: Studies speech perception and phonetics, examining geographic mobility and prosodic variation in American English.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语音感知和音系学，探讨地理流动性对美式英语词汇处理以及声学变体的影响。

faculty.name: Micha Elsner
faculty.summary: Studies language acquisition and discourse structure through computational models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言习得和话语结构的认知模型和计算模型。

faculty.name: Karee Garvin
faculty.summary: Studies speech production and phonetics-phonology interface through EMA and fieldwork, focusing on Nafaanra.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究发音生产和音系-音位界面，通过EMA和田野工作，专注于Nafaanra语言的音系和音位学。

faculty.name: Katherine Howitt
faculty.summary: Studies syntax and child language acquisition through computational methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究句法学和儿童语言获得的计算方法。

faculty.name: Jessica Kantarovich
faculty.summary: Studies language variation and change through fieldwork and experimental methods, focusing on Russian contact varieties and Arctic languages.
faculty.summary_zh: 通过田野调查和实验方法研究语言变异和变化，重点关注俄罗斯接触变体和北极语言。

faculty.name: Bjoern Koehnlein
faculty.summary: Studies the interactions of metrical structure, (intonational) tone, and segmental structure in tone accent languages through fieldwork and theoretical phonology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究韵律结构、（声调）重音和音段结构之间的相互作用，特别是在重音声调语言中的田野调查和理论音系学。

faculty.name: Robert Levine
faculty.summary: Studies syntax, semantics, and their interface using feature logics and type logics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究句法学、语义学及其接口，使用特征逻辑和类型逻辑。

faculty.name: Rebecca Morley
faculty.summary: Studies the phonetics/phonology interface, sound change models, and phonological universals through learning algorithms and computational models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究音系学/音法学界面、音素变化模型和音系普遍性通过学习算法和计算模型。

faculty.name: Prerna Nadathur
faculty.summary: Studies semantics, lexical semantics, pragmatics, and causal reasoning through educational research.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语义学、词汇语义学、语用学以及因果推理，通过教育研究进行探索。

faculty.name: Dan Parker
faculty.summary: Studies sentence processing and syntactic representations in working memory using experimental, computational, and formal methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究句子处理和句法表示在工作记忆中的使用，采用实验、计算和形式方法。

faculty.name: Joy Peltier
faculty.summary: Studies language contact, emergence, and change in Creole languages like Dominica Creole and African American Language, focusing on pragmatic markers and metalinguistic knowledge.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究克里奥尔语言如多米尼克克里奥尔语和非洲美国语言的语言接触、演变和共时变化，关注语用标记和元语言知识。

faculty.name: Michael White
faculty.summary: Studies natural language generation and spoken language dialogue systems using computational methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自然语言生成和口语对话系统，采用计算方法。

faculty.name: Patricia Sieber
faculty.summary: Studies traditional Chinese performance genres and their global afterlives through print and digital media.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究中国传统表演艺术及其全球传承，通过印刷和数字媒体进行探索。

faculty.name: Mark Bender
faculty.summary: Studies oral literature and traditional performance of local Han and ethnic minorities in China through published works and seminars.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究中国汉族和少数民族的传统口头文学和表演艺术，通过出版物和研讨会进行。

faculty.name: Marjorie K. M. Chan
faculty.summary: Studies Chinese prosody, phonetics, and dialectology through synchronic and diachronic analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究汉语音系学、音系学（同步和历时）以及方言学。

faculty.name: Meow Hui Goh
faculty.summary: Studies the affective and emotional impact of early medieval Chinese texts, focusing on political prose, literature as memory, and sound and sight in poetry.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究早期中古汉语文本的情感与情绪影响，关注政治散文、文学记忆以及诗歌中的声音与视觉。

faculty.name: Xiaobin Jian
faculty.summary: Studies Chinese language pedagogy and cross-cultural communication, integrating culture into language instruction and developing advanced language curricula.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究汉语教学和跨文化交际，将文化融入语言教学，并开发高级语言课程。

faculty.name: Pil Ho Kim
faculty.summary: Studies modern Korean society and culture, focusing on popular music and cinema, with a particular emphasis on K-pop and its global impact.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究现代韩国社会和文化，特别是流行音乐和电影，重点关注K-pop及其全球影响。

faculty.name: Hayana Kim
faculty.summary: Studies cultures of democracy in contemporary South Korea through performances and media, focusing on women’s roles in democratization movements.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究当代韩国的民主文化，重点关注女性在民主化运动中的角色和表演媒体的作用。

faculty.name: Keita Moore
faculty.summary: Studies the sociocultural politics of Japanese videogames and their impact on social regulation and norms of childhood.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究日本电子游戏的社会文化政治及其对儿童规范的影响。

faculty.name: Olan Munson
faculty.summary: Studies modern and contemporary Korean literature, focusing on poetry and poetics, with a transpacific approach.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究现代和当代韩国文学，侧重于诗歌和诗学，具有跨太平洋视角。

faculty.name: Danielle O. Pyun
faculty.summary: Studies Korean as a second and foreign language pedagogy, focusing on learner variables, task-based learning, and curricular materials.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究韩语作为第二语言和外语的教学，重点关注学习者变量、任务型教学和课程材料。

faculty.name: Zhiguo Xie
faculty.summary: Studies Chinese semantics and its interaction with syntax and pragmatics, focusing on modality and sociolinguistics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究汉语语义及其与句法和语用学的交互，重点关注情态和社会语言学。

faculty.name: Etsuyo Yuasa
faculty.summary: Studies Japanese grammar and pedagogy, focusing on grammatical exceptions and cultural influences on language use.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究日语语法和教学，关注语法例外和文化对语言使用的影响。

faculty.name: Angela Brintlinger
faculty.summary: Studies Russian literature and culture, focusing on 18th-21st century authors and their readers.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究俄罗斯文学和文化，重点关注18至21世纪的作者及其读者。

faculty.name: Dima Arzyutov
faculty.summary: Studies the intellectual and environmental history of the Arctic, focusing on nuclearization and militarization, and the role of Indigenous and local communities.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究北极的知识和环境历史，重点关注核化和军事化，以及土著和当地社区的作用。

faculty.name: Alexander Burry
faculty.summary: Studies the influence of Pushkin’s Don Juan legend on Russian literature through the ages.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究普希金唐璜传奇对俄罗斯文学各时期的深远影响。

faculty.name: Daniel Collins
faculty.summary: Studies historical pragmatics through the analysis of medieval Russian texts, focusing on speech reporting strategies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究历史语用学，通过分析中世纪俄文文本，关注言语报道策略。

faculty.name: Yana Hashamova
faculty.summary: Studies cultural representations of power dynamics in Balkan film, literature, and media through interdisciplinary approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究巴尔干半岛的文化表现中的权力动态，采用跨学科方法。

faculty.name: Ludmila Isurin
faculty.summary: Studies memory and bilingualism, first and second language acquisition, and collective memory through interdisciplinary sociocognitive frameworks.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究记忆和双语主义、第一语言和第二语言习得以及集体记忆，通过跨学科的认知框架。

faculty.name: Alisa Ballard Lin
faculty.summary: Studies theater history, philosophy, and performance in East Central Europe, focusing on modernism and religious performance.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究东欧中部剧场史、哲学和表演，重点关注现代主义和宗教表演。

faculty.name: Sunnie Rucker-Chang
faculty.summary: Studies race and nationalism in Central and Southeast Europe through literature and film, focusing on marginalized communities and migration.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究中南欧和东南欧的种族和民族主义，通过文学和电影关注边缘化社区和移民。

faculty.name: Saul Noam Zaritt
faculty.summary: Studies modern Jewish writing and translation, focusing on Yiddish literature and its interaction with world literature.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究现代犹太文学和翻译，重点关注意第绪语文学与其与世界文学的互动。
